verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents Machine-to-Machine client credentials, where an app or agent authenticates with a Client ID and Secret to get an access token, and handles authorization with scopes and granular permissions for M2M communication. Its AI offering adds a unique identity per agent and delegated OAuth access that keeps agents from broad, unrestricted access to user data. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on configuring per-agent scope grants or credential rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-scoped credential issuance.
